_comment: PLACEHOLDER TOPOLOGY: Harsh must verify this against the real system before deploy. ADD and UPDATE are structurally identical (each: condition, semantic, classify, and one of 7 builders). Agent nodes excluding the SYSTEM terminal total 22; the demo keeps "19-agent" as its established name. No prompts or Oracle data fields.

nodes.label: Splitter
nodes.role: Decomposes the request into a JSON payload of ADD, UPDATE and DELETE operations handled in parallel.
nodes.guardNote: Rejects malformed requests and enforces the payload schema before fan-out.

nodes.label: Condition
nodes.role: Extracts the conditions the new rule should apply under.
nodes.guardNote: Validates extracted conditions against allowed fields.

nodes.label: Semantic
nodes.role: Resolves the rule meaning into the shared intermediate representation.
nodes.guardNote: Retries on low-confidence resolutions before proceeding.

nodes.label: Classify
nodes.role: Classifies the request to route it to exactly one of the seven list builders.
nodes.guardNote: Falls back to a default list when classification is ambiguous.
